title: Structure exceptional value of the rational coefficient unit
statement: Fix the finite-field datum D, l different from its characteristic, a separated finite-type D.k-scheme X, an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l, and any normalized exceptional system S at the structure morphism [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. For any finite coefficient field F and coherent integral dualizing datum w [def-sf-coherent-integral-dualizing-datum], the rationalization of w.omega is isomorphic to the value of S at its recorded structure compactification and rational F on coefficientUnit, the localized completed regular module. This is DualizingIdentification [def-sf-rational-verdier-identifications].

proof.text: At the integral stage, choose the coefficient object U whose ambient inclusion is identified with the completed constant coefficient object. The integral exceptional adjunction and the coherent integral dualizing datum identify the exceptional value of the normalized operation at U with w.omega. This is the integral comparison supplied by the bridge theorem. Localize this isomorphism along the rational compact-support functor and compose with the right component of the normalized rationalization comparison. The resulting isomorphism has source the rationalization of w.omega and target the recorded exceptional value on coefficientUnit; the defining equality of coefficientUnit and rationalization on U closes the identification.

source.place: Proof, paragraph 7: identify the integral exceptional value and localize it to the rational coefficient unit
